cd /tmp/pit && for i in 1 2; do npx vitest run test/durable/settled-output.test.ts 2>&1 | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' | grep -E 'Tests '; done; npx --no-install oxfmt --check CHANGELOG.md src test >/dev/null && echo fmt-ok; git add -A && git -c user.name=pi-action-agent -c user.email=pi@noreply commit -q -m "fix(durable): drop shell output that arrives after the call settled

When a pi-durable session failed while a program's command still
printed, the output left in the pipe reached api.output after the call
settled. pi-durable threw 'Tool call ... has settled' from the child's
stdout handler, and the host process (pi-action) crashed.

Seen in https://github.com/cv/pi-action/actions/runs/43520110827." && git format-patch -1 --stdout > /tmp/pit-fix.patch; wc -l /tmp/pit-fix.patch
